name: Missoula Bench Builder
old_description: “I want a beautiful, custom piece of furniture that’s crafted from reclaimed materials… is there anybody that can do that?”
about:
Missoula Bench Builder operates from Missoula, Montana, where founder Ryan Hollingsworth designs and builds custom furniture from reclaimed materials sourced from the state’s historic structures. The business began as a solo woodworking venture focused on preserving local history through functional pieces.

The shop produces one-of-a-kind tables, bookcases, bars, benches, and other furniture using a three-step collaborative process: clients select reclaimed materials, Hollingsworth develops a design, and the finished piece is delivered. All work is performed in-house, with each item handcrafted to the customer’s specifications.

The company serves residential clients and interior designers seeking distinctive, story-rich furnishings. Past projects include an eight-foot barnwood bookcase with adjustable shelves, a rustic high-top bar for a home entertainment area, and an entryway bench crafted from reclaimed barn flooring.

Missoula Bench Builder differentiates itself through responsibly reclaimed materials, fully custom designs, and the “Montana Made” provenance of every piece built personally by Hollingsworth.
built_on: Responsibly reclaimed materials from Montana historic buildings
type_evidence: Each piece of furniture designed and brought to life by you and Missoula Bench Builder, Ryan Hollingsworth, preserves a piece of history through the reclaimed materials of Montana’s most historic buildings.
